reason: Both reviews call for wording changes to three star-name claims. Existing cited evidence, including X-17999ee51cf046684881 and the CUHK 火/晶 records, supports explaining that 字源 cautiously says 火星 without naming 心宿二 or Mars, while CUHK identifies the historical star as 大火/心宿二. The text can preserve the attested star-name sense and its unresolved naming motivation without new research.
